profile.subject: a husky
profile.styleHints: Black-and-white husky fur, erect ears, blue eyes, fluffy curled tail, smiling mouth

cycle.prompt: Same black-and-white husky with blue eyes, erect ears, fluffy curled tail, strict side profile facing right, one eye visible, same size every frame, walking trot, 4 equal columns with wide magenta gaps, horizontal sprite sheet of exactly 4 frames

profile.idlePrompt: Pose: standing in side view facing right, all four paws planted, chest out, head high, fluffy tail curled behind

rest.label: Sit
rest.prompt: Pose: sitting upright on haunches, front legs straight, chest fluffy, head turned right, tail curled around paws

sleep.label: Sleep
sleep.prompt: Pose: curled up on side, paws tucked, fluffy tail over nose, eyes closed, relaxed breathing

voice.label: Howl
voice.prompt: Pose: sitting, chest out, muzzle lifted up, mouth open howling, ears back, tail still

trick.label: Shake Paw
trick.prompt: Pose: sitting and lifting right front paw forward, head tilted right, mouth open smile, tail wagging

lines: I love you to the moon!

facts.text: Huskies were bred by the Chukchi people to pull sleds.
Huskies have a thick double coat to stay warm in snow.
Huskies can have blue eyes, and sometimes one of each color.
